cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Warmly Enforced
cards.instruction: Remain kind and welcoming while enforcing increasingly restrictive rules without exception.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. We're so glad you're staying. The guest bed is yours; just no food upstairs.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Of course. I'll have my breakfast downstairs.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. Lovely. After nine, please; we keep the kitchen quiet before then.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: My train's at eight. Could I take a banana?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd love you to have one. Breakfast food stays in the kitchen, though. Can you catch a later train?

mechanism: A warmly treats B as welcome while retaining sole authority over increasingly restrictive permissions, letting each attempted accommodation reveal another unwaived boundary.
confusable: Cold gatekeeping is confusable: A warmth must remain sincere throughout, including the actual refusal rather than only an opening welcome.
comparison: Houseguest breakfast collides with an early train; prospective swimmer cannot complete prerequisite observation because access itself requires induction.
seedUse: Both cards and all four seeds read. Preserve helpful welcome and actual restrictions, removing generic reprimands that undermine warmth and making A settle the offered alternatives.
